skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: The Remains of Time
skins.content: Test Collection Series/The Remains of Time. An outfit worn by Kal'tsit while in disguise. Countless times, in this manner, she influenced the course of Terra's civilization—ripples in the great river of time, a fleeting mark on her endless journey.
skins.quote: She walked the mountain called Time, calling into the eternal, empty valley, and found an echo of life. 'Kal'tsit, have you found yourself?'

skins.name: Remnant
skins.content: Bloodline of Combat Collection/Remnant. Originium has taken over the land, and what she envisioned has become a reality. She has enumerated and entrusted everything else to the others, leaving only her name as she hones her mission into a sharp blade.
skins.usage: One of Kal'tsit's outfits for crucial moments.
skins.quote: 'I'm Kal'tsit, a doctor of Rhodes Island, and also the companion of Amiya and the Doctor. You have long been worthless to me.'
